name: Airflow job example
description: A button starts the Apache Airflow DAG datorio_demo_sales_summary with the parameters of the report, shows the progress of the run and refreshes the report with its result.

parameters.name: run_id
parameters.label: Run shown below (click a row in "Job runs"; empty = the latest successful run)

widgets.body: How it works. The button sends the region, the period and "Fail at step" applied on the left panel to the Airflow DAG datorio_demo_sales_summary as its run configuration, together with your user name. The progress bar under the button shows the current step of the run and the elapsed time. When the run is over, the report refreshes: the run appears in "Job runs" and its result is shown below. Set "Fail at step" to 1-4 and press "Apply" to see how a failed run looks. The example needs the Airflow container from examples/airflow/compose.yml; its UI is on port 8088 (user datorio, password datorio).

widgets.title: Start the job
widgets.chartConfig: {"buttonType": "RUN_JOB", "label": "Start the job", "color": "green", "size": "large", "jobId": "datorio_demo_sales_summary", "jobParams": ["region", "date_from", "date_to", "fail_at_step"], "jobUserParam": "started_by", "confirmText": "Start the Airflow DAG datorio_demo_sales_summary with the region, period and \"Fail at step\" applied on the panel?"}

widgets.title: Job runs
widgets.rawSql:
SELECT
    formatDateTime(finished_at, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%S') AS `Finished, UTC`,
    run_id AS `Run`,
    started_by AS `Started by`,
    region AS `Region`,
    concat(toString(date_from), ' - ', toString(date_to)) AS `Period`,
    status AS `Status`,
    failed_step AS `Failed step`,
    message AS `Message`,
    orders AS `Orders`,
    revenue AS `Revenue`
FROM sample.job_runs
ORDER BY finished_at DESC
LIMIT 20
widgets.chartConfig: {"tableDensity": "compact", "tablePageSize": 10, "rowColorBy": "Status", "rowColorMode": "cell", "rowColors": {"success": "#dcfce7", "failed": "#fee2e2"}, "clickParams": [{"column": "Run", "param": "run_id"}], "description": "Click a row to show the result of that run below."}

widgets.title: Revenue of the run
widgets.rawSql:
WITH chosen AS
(
    SELECT if(:run_id = '', (
        SELECT argMax(run_id, finished_at)
        FROM sample.job_runs
        WHERE status = 'success'
    ), :run_id) AS c_run_id
)
SELECT
    revenue AS `Revenue`,
    if(previous_revenue = 0, NULL, round((toFloat64(revenue) - toFloat64(previous_revenue)) / toFloat64(previous_revenue) * 100, 1)) AS `Change, %`,
    concat(region, ', ', toString(date_from), ' - ', toString(date_to)) AS `Run`
FROM sample.job_runs
WHERE run_id IN (SELECT c_run_id FROM chosen)
  AND status = 'success'

widgets.title: Orders of the run
widgets.rawSql:
WITH chosen AS
(
    SELECT if(:run_id = '', (
        SELECT argMax(run_id, finished_at)
        FROM sample.job_runs
        WHERE status = 'success'
    ), :run_id) AS c_run_id
)
SELECT
    orders AS `Orders`,
    CAST(NULL, 'Nullable(Float64)') AS `Change, %`,
    concat(region, ', ', toString(date_from), ' - ', toString(date_to)) AS `Run`
FROM sample.job_runs
WHERE run_id IN (SELECT c_run_id FROM chosen)
  AND status = 'success'

widgets.title: Result by category
widgets.rawSql:
WITH chosen AS
(
    SELECT if(:run_id = '', (
        SELECT argMax(run_id, finished_at)
        FROM sample.job_runs
        WHERE status = 'success'
    ), :run_id) AS c_run_id
)
SELECT
    category AS `Category`,
    orders AS `Orders`,
    revenue AS `Revenue`,
    top_product AS `Top product`
FROM sample.job_results
WHERE run_id IN (SELECT c_run_id FROM chosen)
ORDER BY revenue DESC
